manifest.name: Vyx AI
manifest.description: Optional native AI chat with separately configured providers, encrypted local history, and individually reviewed server actions. Missing a provider? Open an issue to request support. https://github.com/Mondrethos/vyx/issues/new

commands.title: Open Vyx AI chat
commands.description: Open native server-aware chat. Provider credentials and data sharing are configured only in host-owned settings.

commands.title: Configure Vyx AI
commands.description: Manage provider profiles, independent capabilities, local history, and usage. AI is off until explicitly enabled.
